thesis_points: Quality over speed: replacing Forever 21 vacancies (~570K sqft) with experiential anchors at >2x legacy rents

16 consecutive quarters of positive leasing spreads; SNO pipeline $90–140M+; new leases 9% above renewals

overview.narrative:
Housing and Office REITs led the tape today, averaging +2.72% and +2.43% respectively, as declining long-end rates and stronger-than-expected existing home sales data fueled a broad rotation into rate-sensitive names. NexPoint Residential Trust surged +9.48%, likely on positioning ahead of earnings, while AVB's +5.29% move reflects renewed institutional appetite for coastal multifamily.
